total_physical_cost.note: Warm readouts are reused controls; four_new_transfer_readouts excludes them. Service seconds are summed request durations, not allocation wall time.

root_concentration.depth5: 0/6 in every cell on the same three roots; these repeated observations are correlated, not 36 independent depth-5 tasks.
root_concentration.note: Every between-cell native-score disagreement lies on the two listed task/seed pairs; cost differences are broader and are not restricted to these roots.

method.pairing: Native audit scores keyed by actual (task_id, seed), all sixteen keys identical in every cell. Root quantities/inventories use identical tasks.jsonl bytes; world and runtime contracts match.
method.native_authority: Existing completed NATIVE-AUDIT.json and frozen COMPARISON.json, not a new scoring implementation.
method.small_receipts: 236 small input hashes checked/recorded, including six PLAN/audit/SUMMARY triplets, all 96 episode files, all 96 first-call receipts, committed actor JSON and familiar comparison receipts. Native audit hashes seal remaining call/node evidence without rehashing all traces or weights.
method.uncertainty: Paired mean over eight root clusters. Seeded percentile bootstrap of cluster means: random.Random(20260928), 10000 samples, size 8 with replacement, sorted entries 249/9749. Includes two rollout repeats together. Conditions on one world and one realized optimizer update per training interface; excludes training-seed variation and multiplicity adjustment.
method.zero_interval: The exact [0,0] bootstrap interval for the all-tie binder-trained/binder comparison is a degenerate empirical resampling result, not evidence of population equivalence or zero future benefit.
method.scope: Prospectively fixed, root-disjoint official TRAIN diagnostic B, not official VAL/HOLDOUT or unseen recipe components. B was excluded from gradients but is repeatedly exposed in this adaptive campaign.

decisions.decision: Complete the already fixed first fresh-A collection/update/B readouts and extra-SFT comparison; keep all predeclared checkpoints.
decisions.reason: This probe shows limited transfer from familiar goals, not that RL cannot transfer. Fresh-A uses disjoint and difficulty-matched optimization roots; extra SFT tests whether an additional update already helps.
decisions.do_not: Use B rewards as training labels, select a best B checkpoint, replace hard B roots, or change accepted continuation gates.

decisions.decision: Judge subsequent fixed endpoints by paired root gains and cost, not familiar-goal accuracy or optimizer movement.
decisions.reason: A broad-transfer claim would need gains beyond one borderline root plus independent confirmation. Until then prioritize interpretation of accepted controls over a new grid.
decisions.extra_sft_limit: One extra SFT step matches start/LR/arithmetic/step count, not data, targets, token dose or FLOPs; it is not a fully controlled RL-versus-SFT efficacy comparison.
